_notes: engine.targets.*: url follows the v0.4.0 release asset naming (condense-server-<triple>.tar.gz/.zip); sha256/size are null because no tagged release exists yet — they are filled in from the CI-built release assets once `v0.4.0` is tagged.

engine.targets.x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.binary_path: verified via `tar -tzf` against a real condense-server-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz built by scripts/build-server-bundle.sh — the archive's single top-level dir is `condense-server-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/`, containing `engine/sift-engine` (the PyInstaller onedir entry point, with its `_internal/` support dir alongside it), `bin/sift-agent-cli`, `run.sh`, `run.bat`, `env.example`, `README.md`.

engine.targets.aarch64-apple-darwin / x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.binary_path: NOT verified (no macOS/Windows artifact was inspected) — inferred by analogy to the Linux layout (the same build-server-bundle.sh script presumably produces the same `condense-server-<triple>/engine/sift-engine[.exe]` shape per target). Confirm via `tar -tzf` / `unzip -l` before shipping a real release.

embedder.targets.x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu: verified — archive downloaded, sha256 + size measured directly, binary_path confirmed via `tar -tzf` (llama-b9878/llama-server present alongside 62 other files/libs in the release tarball).

embedder.targets.aarch64-apple-darwin / x86_64-pc-windows-msvc: url + size taken from the b9878 GitHub release API (ggml-org/llama.cpp) without downloading the archive — sha256 is null pending a real download, and binary_path is an unverified inference from the Linux archive's internal layout (macOS: same `llama-b9878/llama-server` name; Windows: same name + `.exe`). Both must be confirmed before shipping a real release.
model: gpustack/bge-m3-GGUF Q8_0 quant — sha256 + size measured directly from the downloaded bge-m3-Q8_0.gguf.

Unpacking convention (backend.rs/provisioning.rs): archives are extracted WITHOUT stripping their top-level directory — `binary_path` is always relative to the component's own runtime dir (`runtime/engine/`, `runtime/embedder/`) and includes whatever leading path segment the upstream archive happens to use (e.g. `condense-server-<triple>/engine/sift-engine`, `llama-b9878/llama-server`).

reranker: gpustack/bge-reranker-v2-m3-GGUF Q8_0, the cross-encoder the MITRE eval picked (top-1 0.69 -> 0.82 over 306 answerable questions). sha256 + size measured 2026-11-17 from the file downloaded off this URL. Served by the SAME llama-server binary as the embedder (`--reranking`, port `reranker_port`, default 8803), so it is a model file only, like `model`. Optional: a manifest without it still parses, and an install without it still auto-starts (the reranker downloads in the background).
